description: Gestionnaires des milieux aquatiques et prévention des inondations (GEMAPI) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département de l'Isère. Scope of river managers with GEMAPI competence. Public institutions in charge of river management and GEMAPI (Aquatic Environment Management and Flood Prevention). Coverage: Département de l'Isère. The portal shows the English title as "Aquatic Environment Managers and Flood Prevention (GEMAPI)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Département de l'Isère. Its keywords include environnement-agriculture-eau, eau, riviere, gestionnaire, gemapi. The listing shows 4 download or service links in ZIP, JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2026-08-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
